Used only through the low-level push API (`drmp3dec_init`, `drmp3dec_decode_frame`) from `src/mp3.cpp`; compiled once in
`src/dr_mp3_impl.c` with `DR_MP3_NO_STDIO` and `DR_MP3_NO_SIMD`. The decoder state (`drmp3dec`, ~23 KB, includes the
scratch buffers) is allocated by the caller, in PSRAM on the device. Do not edit this file; update it by replacing it
with a newer upstream revision and updating the table above (docs/FIRMWARE_TOOLCHAIN.md §9).
